articles.title: A Rocket Just Smashed Into the Moon — and Scientists Are Excited!
articles.summary: A SpaceX rocket crashed into the moon at 5,400 mph this morning. Now, orbiters are trying to photograph the new crater. Scientists hope it will teach us more about the moon!

articles.title: Wolves Are Back in Yellowstone — and They're a Big Deal!
articles.summary: Wolves were wiped out from Yellowstone by 1926, but they were brought back in 1995. Now the park is the best place in the US to see them. Here's the amazing story of their return!

articles.title: Huge Hidden Magma Found Under Tuscany — Like 2.4 Billion Swimming Pools!
articles.summary: Scientists found a giant magma system hidden beneath Tuscany, Italy. It's as big as 2.4 billion Olympic swimming pools! But don't worry — it's not a threat right now.
